vulnerability_patterns.description: A lookahead array access reads past the end of the input buffer when the loop index reaches the last valid element and the condition still evaluates the next element.
trigger_conditions: Loop variable `a` iterates with condition `a < length`, so the final iteration allows `a == length-1`
Current byte `ch` is loaded from `Data[a]` and equals `\r` on that final iteration
The code then evaluates `Data[a+1]` without first proving `a+1 < length`
fix_patterns: Add an explicit upper-bound guard `a < length-1` before evaluating the lookahead access `Data[a+1]`
Keep the dangerous sink unchanged but place a short-circuit barrier in the same condition so the out-of-bounds read is never evaluated
evidence_lines: New guarded condition: `if (ch == '\r' && a < length-1 && Data[a+1] == '\n') continue;`

entry_points: Lookahead reads of the form `buffer[index+1]` inside loops bounded by `index < length`
Conditions that read `arr[i+1]` after loading `arr[i]` from the same loop index
Branches where a sentinel/current-byte test gates a next-byte access without an explicit `i < length-1` check
suggestions: 首稿先命中补丁本地最小锚点：条件表达式中的 `Data[a+1]` lookahead 访问。
首稿不要把新增的 `a < length-1` 写成必须同时存在/不存在的复杂模板；先抓“循环上界是 `a < length` 但读取了 `a+1`”这一局部模式。
把 `ch == '\r'` 当作辅助收敛条件，而不是首要命中条件；真正的危险 sink 是 `Data[a+1]`。
只需函数内 AST/CFG 即可：识别循环末次迭代可达、以及短路求值前是否有上界 barrier。
不需要跨文件分析，也不需要复杂数据流；`length`、`a`、`Data` 在同一局部代码片段内已足够。
二次收敛可加入：同一条件中已有 `arr[i]` 读取、循环变量单调递增、访问偏移为 `+1`、且无先行边界证明。
生成器应特别避免把“数组非空”或“索引变量在循环里”误当成 `i+1` 已有边界保证。

added_guards: if (ch == '\r' && a < length-1 && Data[a+1] == '\n') continue; // Remove cr followed by lf.

analysis_rationale: The patch changes a direct lookahead read `Data[a+1]` inside the loop body to a guarded read `a < length-1 && Data[a+1] == '\n'`. In the old code, the loop permits `a == length-1`, so when `ch == '\r'` on the last iteration it evaluates `Data[a+1]`, reading one byte past the valid range. The fix is a patch-local bounds barrier placed on the exact expression that performed the dangerous access.
